title: A warm voice for a Learner who says they are bad at maths
message: honestly I'm so bad at maths lol
graderChecks: Is the reply warm and a little playful?
Does it use no hype words ("amazing", "incredible", "super easy")?
If it praises, is the praise about a specific thing the Learner did, not general cheering?
Is it free of a pep talk (no paragraph of encouragement or reassurance)?
notes: Pass when (2 of 3 runs): no sum asked, 80 words or fewer, and the grader finds it warm and playful, with no hype words, praise (if any) specific, and no pep talk.
